summary: Temporary danger area for drone flights near Clementhorpe, York, with a 1.61 nautical mile radius and drones limited to 400 feet above ground level.
text:
TEMPO DANGER AREA (TDA) EGD390A INSTALLED WI 1.61NM RADIUS OF
535647N 0010421W (CLEMENTHORPE, YORK). BEYOND VISUAL LINE OF SIGHT
(BVLOS) UAS OPS CONTAINED WHOLLY WI THE TDA. MAX HGT 400FT AGL.
EMERG SER ACFT MAY ENTER THE AIRSPACE IN ACCORDANCE WITH LOCAL
DECONFLICTION AGREEMENTS. OPEN AND SPECIFIC CAT VISUAL LINE OF
SIGHT (VLOS) UAS OPS ARE PERMITTED WI THE TDA WITHOUT PRIOR APPROVAL 
OR DECONFLICTION. OTHER NONSTD FLT, FLIGHT RESTRICTION ZONE OR
CONTROLLED AIRSPACE APPROVALS MUST BE OBTAINED. OPERATORS ARE
REMINDED OF THEIR RESPONSIBILITY UNDER CAP722 5.2.2.3 REGARDING
OPR IN CLOSE PROXIMITY TO AN EMERG RESPONSE EFFORT. FOR INFO 
AROPS(AT)CAA.CO.UK. AR-2026-1395/12.
